chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Marry off the foolish man, but do not marry the foolish woman, for the foolish man may produce noble offspring, whereas the foolish woman does not produce noble offspring.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.يَنْجُبُ: to produce noble or distinguished offspring

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about marrying a foolish man or woman?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام gives ethical guidance concerning marriage choice and family formation. It distinguishes between the consequences of marrying a foolish man and a foolish woman, presenting this as practical counsel regarding offspring and household outcomes.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4929 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Marry off the foolish man, but do not marry the foolish woman, for the foolish man may produce offspring, whereas the foolish woman does not bear children."
